findings.interpretation: A quoted full Scope Unit path is one string value and may contain slash characters. The proposed / containment operator is CFEL syntax when parsed as an expression. These are different contexts; neither changes a filesystem folder or admits an address merely by spelling.
findings.next_source_obligation: Define full-path string grammar, validation and explicit conversion to the resolved Scope Unit target; do not parse arbitrary unquoted source text as a path value.

findings.interpretation: The illustrative /~ENGINE/PROGRAMMATIC path is not evidence of an existing ENGINE Scope Unit or alias. Current R2653 declares FRAMEWORK_ENGINE and R2654 declares PROGRAMMATIC as its child. The marker ~ and segment encoding are not defined by those Declarations.
findings.next_source_obligation: Treat it as illustrative; do not rename FRAMEWORK_ENGINE, assume an ENGINE alias, or rename directories.

findings.interpretation: User proposes one full Scope Unit path string. Current R2530 describes a Scope Unit.Path as one or more strings listing identities from root; it does not itself define the proposed single-string serialized form.
findings.next_source_obligation: Review an explicit source successor and migration/compatibility mapping before treating the one-string form as Current.

findings.interpretation: User identifies Project root path as /. Current R2524 says Project is root with no Scope Unit parent. R2684 says a Scope Unit Declaration Atom is external to the Scope Unit it declares; the root Project Declaration Atom must still have its own Container under the accepted every-Atom rule.
findings.next_source_obligation: Resolve an independently valid external container for the Project Declaration Atom, or an explicit governed exception; / identifies the Project itself and cannot by itself establish an external container. Do not fabricate a Scope Unit.Header or external Atom.

findings.interpretation: The Header.Container candidate specifies a single string containing a full Scope Unit path or base Atom ID, with base ID selecting Current. Proposed <Node> and $x[<Node>] describe Model-kind and selected-object semantics, not a change to the stored string value Format.
findings.next_source_obligation: Keep stored string and resolved target distinct; add an explicit, separately governed target-resolution contract before treating the value as an object reference. Do not coerce strings into objects, invent a new Property or silently replace [string] with an object Format.
